intro: If you want a Kaeng Khoi stay with rooms that are new, clean and affordable — perfect for an overnight stop or as a base for driving around Saraburi and Khao Yai — The Bua Boutique Resort is a 38-room boutique hotel that opened in 2022 on Mittraphap Road in Ban Pa, Kaeng Khoi. The draws are newly decorated minimalist rooms, smart TVs, strong showers, free parking, and a breakfast that many real guests single out for praise. Prices start at around ฿650/night, with a score of 7.5 from real reviews across platforms — a genuinely good-value pick in this area.

body.html: What makes The Bua Boutique Resort a popular choice around Kaeng Khoi is simple: it is new and clean at an affordable price. Opened in 2022 and kept up since, the rooms and common areas still feel fresh, decorated in an easy-on-the-eye minimalist style. Real guests repeatedly use words like good value, clean rooms, friendly staff and quiet atmosphere. This is a hotel that sells simplicity and value rather than luxury, ideal for travellers who want a decent room on a tight budget.

There is a sensible spread of room types, from Standard twin and king rooms of around 24 sqm, to a triple room of around 32 sqm, up to a Premium room for four. Every room has air conditioning, a fridge, a smart TV, and a bathroom that reviewers praise for its strong shower and good hot water. The fresh, clean decor is the most consistently complimented feature. It suits couples, small families, and groups of friends who want a three- or four-bed room in one place.

The common areas are kept simple but practical. There is a restaurant and cafe, a fitness room (for an extra charge), free parking and free Wi-Fi. A recurring point in reviews is the breakfast, which many guests say is tastier and more generous than expected at this price. Beds are comfortable, and the roadside Mittraphap Road location is easy to get in and out of — both for people passing through for the night and for those using it as a base to explore Saraburi.
"New, clean room, comfortable bed, strong shower, breakfast better than expected, friendly staff — really good value for an overnight stop on the road."

To be honest about the trade-offs: this is a simple hotel with no swimming pool and none of the facilities of a big resort. Some reviews mention uncomfortable pillows, cleaning that is occasionally inconsistent, and a bathroom odour in some rooms. A few guests note barking dogs on the property that can be disruptive on some nights. These are the kinds of details you find at budget hotels — understand the price level and set expectations accordingly, and it still comes out as good value overall.

The other thing to weigh is location: the Mittraphap Road setting is convenient for driving but there are no shops or sights within walking distance. It suits people with a car far more than those without one. It is about a 20-minute drive into Saraburi town and works well as a stop before heading up to Khao Yai or out along the Pa Sak River. If you specifically want a resort feel set in nature or by the water, this is not it — but for a clean, new, budget room right on the highway, the location is spot on.

Overall, The Bua Boutique Resort scores about 7.5 out of 10 across real reviews on several platforms. It is a straightforward boutique hotel that fits travellers wanting a new, clean, affordable room for an overnight stop or a base in Saraburi. Prices start around ฿650 and climb with season and room type into the low thousands for three- to four-bed rooms. If you can accept the lack of a pool and the small quirks of a budget hotel, this delivers value that is hard to find around Kaeng Khoi.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — The Bua Boutique Resort Saraburi

faq.q: Where is The Bua Boutique Resort in Saraburi?
faq.a: The Bua Boutique Resort is at 224 Ban Pa, Mittraphap Road, Kaeng Khoi, Saraburi Province. It is a roadside location with easy access, about a 20-minute drive into Saraburi town. It suits travellers with a car who want an overnight stop or a base for exploring Saraburi and Khao Yai.

faq.q: How much does The Bua Boutique Resort cost and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Prices start at around ฿650/night for a Standard twin room. Options range from a Standard king and a triple room up to a Premium room for four. Rates move with season and room type into the low thousands for three- to four-bed rooms — always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does The Bua Boutique Resort have a swimming pool?
faq.a: No, there is no swimming pool. This is a simple boutique hotel focused on clean rooms at an affordable price. It has a restaurant/cafe, a fitness room (for a surcharge), free parking and free Wi-Fi. If you want a pool and a resort feel, consider a stay along the Pa Sak River or in the Muak Lek / Khao Yai zone instead.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at The Bua Boutique Resort?
faq.a: Rooms are newly decorated in a minimalist style, with the hotel having opened in 2022. Every room has air conditioning, a fridge, a smart TV, and a bathroom guests praise for its strong shower and good hot water. Real reviews highlight the cleanliness and value. Options run from twin and king rooms up to three- and four-bed rooms for groups and families.

faq.q: Who is The Bua Boutique Resort best for?
faq.a: It is ideal for travellers wanting a new, clean, affordable room for an overnight stop or as a base in Saraburi. It suits couples, small families and groups of friends with a car. If you are after a resort in nature with a pool, this may not match your expectations.

faq.q: What should I be aware of before staying at The Bua Boutique Resort?
faq.a: As a budget hotel, set expectations accordingly: there is no pool, and some reviews mention uncomfortable pillows, occasionally inconsistent cleaning, a bathroom odour in some rooms, and barking dogs on some nights. Nothing is within walking distance, so a car helps. Understand the price level and it still represents good value overall.
